name: GOLF (EIGHT CARD)
description: Eight-card Golf: 2+ players, 52 cards. Each has 8 cards in layout (e.g. 2Ã—4). Draw or take discard to replace; aim for lowest point total. Same scoring as 4/6-card Golf; larger layout. Play 9 or 18 holes.

content.text: Eight-card Golf: 2+ players, 52 cards. Each has 8 cards in layout (e.g. 2Ã—4). Draw or take discard to replace; aim for lowest point total. Same scoring as 4/6-card Golf; larger layout. Play 9 or 18 holes.

Golf is widespread in North America and Britain; the eight-card form extends six-card Golf with a larger layout (four columns of two cards per player). It is less widespread than 4- and 6-card Golf. The variant was documented on Bill Whitnack's Card Games site, using a double 52-card deck with jokers for larger groups.
Two to eight players. A standard 52-card pack is used; with more than four players, a second pack (and optionally jokers) may be used.
8 cards each in layout; stock and discard.

items.text: Eight Card Golf with Jokers: Double 52-card deck with four jokers; pair in column scores zero; two equal pairs in any two columns minus 10; jokers minus 5. Nine deals. (Bill Whitnack variant.)
